rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, outer_wall_s=3000, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=1, img_sr=0.005, rationale=iter-3: change EXACTLY ONE knob img_sr 0.02 -> 0.005 (4x TIGHTER image-domain range/intensity sigma). img_n_bf reverted 3->1 to isolate the sigma effect on the minimal 6-param stack (iter-2 proved depth is INEFFECTIVE on Mayo: img_n_bf 1->3 left SSIM 0.9462->0.9452, PSNR 35.60->35.69, hr still 0). FAILURE MODE: both prior iters land PSNR ~35.6 dB which is BELOW the LD-FBP baseline 36.56 dB -- the bilateral filter is DEGRADING an already-clean dense-view (2304-angle) FBP, not denoising it. Design-doc: 'sigma_r >> data range degenerates to a Gaussian'; at img_sr=0.02 on Mayo's normalized HU range the range kernel is too wide, so the image BF collapses toward a plain Gaussian that blurs attenuation edges -> PSNR drops below the FBP input. HYPOTHESIS: a 4x-tighter range sigma (img_sr=0.005) makes the image BF edge-PRESERVING, so it only smooths near-flat noise and stops blurring edges, recovering PSNR ABOVE the 36.56 dB LD-FBP baseline and lifting hr off 0. Everything else held at iter-1 (warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, val_n=6, n_iter=400, grad_clip=1.0, lr=5e-3, proj_n_bf=1, seed=42, default img_sx=img_sy=1.5, proj sigmas at Wagner defaults). val_n back to 6 = same basis as iter-1 for a clean A/B on the sigma. Per-image N2I (commit 1f4c3394): warm-start pre-pass then per-scan Adam fit on each val scan own measurements, scored by evaluate_calibrated on L277 val. NOT amortized.
